test_offline_throughput: test the offline throughput benchmark with a ShareGPT dataset and default args
test_random_dataset_throughput: test the offline throughput benchmark using a random dataset with specified input and output lengths
test_shared_prefix_throughput: test the offline throughput benchmark with a generated-shared-prefix dataset and custom group parameters
run_engine_backend_benchmark: run the throughput benchmark using the engine backend with configurable server and bench arguments
run_ray_engine_benchmark: run the throughput benchmark using a Ray engine backend with placement group GPU allocation
